Macquarie: “Time To Outperform Match Group (MTCH)”
 Gary Bell How Macquarie Currently Rates Match Group (MTCH)
Research professionals at Macquarie has begun coverage Match Group (MTCH) shares in a report made public on Thursday morning, IR.net reports. The financial company has set a Outperform rating on MTCH stock. Match Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:MTCH) Ratings Coverage
Among 5 analysts covering Match Group ( MTCH ), 4 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 80% are positive. Match Group has $70 highest and $46 lowest target. $59’s average target is 42.68% above currents $41.35 stock price. Match Group had 7 analyst reports since June 11, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock of Match Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:MTCH) earned “Buy” rating by Deutsche Bank on Friday, August 17. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Monday, June 11 by Jefferies. BMO Capital Markets maintained Match Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:MTCH) rating on Thursday, August 9. BMO Capital Markets has “Outperform” rating and $52 target. On Thursday, August 9 the stock rating was maintained by Barclays Capital with “Equal-Weight”. Jefferies maintained the shares of MTCH in report on Thursday, October 4 with “Buy” rating. The rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank with “Buy” on Monday, November 5.
The stock increased 3.48% or $1.39 $41.35. About 2.33 million shares traded. Match Group, Inc. (MTCH) has risen 137.10% uptrending. It has outperformed by 121.48% the S&P500.
Match Group, Inc. provides dating products. $11.50 billion. The firm operates in two divisions, Dating and Non-dating. It has a 34.6 P/E ratio. It operates a portfolio of approximately 45 brands, including Match, Tinder, PlentyOfFish, Meetic, OkCupid, Pairs, Twoo, OurTime, BlackPeopleMeet, and LoveScout24.
